source_text: Vendor may issue a refund to Customer after receipt of the returned Product.
notes: MAY + RELATIVE_TO_TRIGGER(AFTER) -- the merged form standing in for the grammar sketch's separate AFTER/BEFORE alternatives (see SPEC.md section 4). Note the absence of a duration here: unlike WITHIN, this form expresses 'sometime after X' with no bounded window -- a real, distinct shape of vagueness that the typechecker may or may not choose to flag, per its own future design.
